title: Digital business card
description: Everything personal on the card. Any string left empty ("") hides that item. Run `node scripts/build.mjs` after editing to regenerate index.html.

name.description: `full` is what visitors see. The parts build the vCard's structured name so contacts apps sort it correctly.

full.description: Name as displayed, e.g. "María José García López".

family.description: Surname(s) the contact should file under, e.g. "García López".

initials.description: Shown in the avatar circle when there is no photo. Defaults to the first letters of given and family name.

photo.description: Square image file next to index.html (e.g. "photo.jpg", ~400×400, under 150 KB) or an https:// URL. Empty shows initials.

role.description: Job title or headline, e.g. "Product Designer".

org.description: Company or organization. Shown after the role and saved to the vCard ORG field.

tagline.description: One short line under the role.

location.description: City and country, e.g. "Mexico City, Mexico".

display.description: How the number is shown, e.g. "+1 202 555 0123". Defaults to `dial`.

dial.description: E.164: + then country code and number, no spaces, e.g. "+12025550123".

number.description: Digits only, country code first, no + or spaces, e.g. "12025550123". Some Mexican mobiles need 521 instead of 52.

message.description: Optional message pre-filled when someone opens the chat.

site.description: Where the card is published, for link previews.

url.description: Public URL of the card, ending in /. Leave empty on GitHub Pages: it is worked out from the repository.

previewImage.description: 1200×630 image file next to index.html, shown when the link is shared in chats. Optional.

vcardFilename.description: Name of the downloaded contact file. Defaults to the full name, e.g. "Maria-Jose-Garcia-Lopez.vcf".

display.description: Short text shown under the icon, e.g. a username. Defaults to the last part of the URL.
